Every day, Taiwan throws away enough food to fill more than two thousand rubbish trucks. Most of this waste does not come from restaurants; it comes from ordinary kitchens. People buy too much, forget what is already in the fridge, and throw away food that is still safe to eat.
Wasting food also wastes water and energy. Growing one kilogram of rice needs about two thousand litres of water. When the rice ends up in the bin, all that water is wasted too.

A teacher is calling a student's mother.
A nurse is teaching a first aid class.
A patient is seeing a doctor about being ill.
explain_zh: 醫生問症狀、檢查喉嚨、給休息建議，是看診的場景。這不是買藥或上課。聽到 What seems to be the problem? 幾乎都是診間對話。

passage:
A: Good morning. What seems to be the problem?
B: I have had a sore throat since Sunday, and last night I started coughing a lot.
A: Any fever?
B: This morning it was thirty-eight point two degrees. I took some medicine my mother had at home.
A: I see. Open your mouth, please. Your throat is quite red, but your lungs sound clear. It is probably a virus, so antibiotics will not help.
B: Do I need to stay home from school?
A: Rest for two days, drink warm water, and wear a mask when you go back. If the fever lasts more than three days, come and see me again.
stem: What was the patient's temperature this morning?
explain_zh: 病人說今天早上量到攝氏三十八點二度。三十九度是醫生提到「要再回診」的門檻，不是今天的體溫。數字題要分清楚「現在的數字」和「警戒的數字」。
